areas.title: Client to server
areas.definition: User actions never reach the backend.

areas.title: Server to client
areas.definition: Backend operations succeed, but the interface never updates.

areas.title: Devvit to Reddit API
areas.definition: Requests succeed without producing the intended result.

areas.title: Devvit to Redis
areas.definition: Data is incorrectly stored, retrieved, or overwritten.

areas.title: Reddit to Devvit
areas.definition: Expected events never reach the application.

areas.title: Function to function
areas.definition: Incorrect, incomplete, or missing parameters are passed between functions.

areas.title: External API integrations
areas.definition: Missing, incomplete, or unexpected responses are accepted as valid.

areas.title: Data serialization
areas.definition: Information is lost, altered, or incorrectly interpreted during conversion.

areas.title: Button clicks
areas.definition: Clicks are registered but no intended action occurs.

areas.title: Event handlers
areas.definition: Handlers are missing, incorrectly bound, or never executed.

areas.title: Form submissions
areas.definition: Forms close without completing the intended operation.

areas.title: Join button
areas.definition: The interface indicates success without confirmed subscription.

areas.title: Secondary action button
areas.definition: Incorrect destinations or fallbacks are selected.

areas.title: Moderator menu actions
areas.definition: Actions are displayed but do not execute.

areas.title: Settings changes
areas.definition: Settings appear saved but are not persisted.

areas.title: Repeated interactions
areas.definition: Duplicate protection incorrectly blocks legitimate actions.

areas.title: Navigation
areas.definition: Redirects never occur or open incorrect destinations.

areas.title: App installation
areas.definition: Required initialization never occurs.

areas.title: App upgrade
areas.definition: Required migrations or initialization procedures never execute.

areas.title: App uninstallation
areas.definition: Required cleanup never occurs.

areas.title: Post creation
areas.definition: Newly created posts are not detected.

areas.title: Post deletion
areas.definition: Deleted goals remain registered as active.

areas.title: Moderator actions
areas.definition: Unhighlighting, removal, or other relevant moderator actions are not detected.

areas.title: Scheduled triggers
areas.definition: Expected scheduled events never execute.

areas.title: Event filtering
areas.definition: Valid events are incorrectly discarded.

areas.title: Trigger registration
areas.definition: Event handlers exist but are never registered.

areas.title: If/else statements
areas.definition: Incorrect execution paths are selected.

areas.title: Early returns
areas.definition: Functions exit before completing required work.

areas.title: Guard clauses
areas.definition: Valid operations are incorrectly blocked.

areas.title: Eligibility checks
areas.definition: Eligible subreddits, users, or operations are classified as ineligible.

areas.title: Permission checks
areas.definition: Authorized users or operations are incorrectly denied functionality.

areas.title: Feature flags
areas.definition: Functionality is unintentionally disabled.

areas.title: Default values
areas.definition: Missing information is interpreted incorrectly.

areas.title: Switch statements
areas.definition: Unexpected cases are silently ignored.

areas.title: Boolean expressions
areas.definition: Multiple conditions interact incorrectly.

areas.title: Optional chaining
areas.definition: Missing objects silently prevent required operations.

areas.title: Redis reads
areas.definition: Missing or invalid data is interpreted as valid data.

areas.title: Redis writes
areas.definition: Incorrect values are persisted.

areas.title: Redis keys
areas.definition: Information is stored under or retrieved from incorrect keys.

areas.title: Key expiration
areas.definition: Required information disappears prematurely.

areas.title: Cached data
areas.definition: Outdated information is treated as current.

areas.title: Data migrations
areas.definition: Existing installations retain incompatible or outdated data.

areas.title: Data deletion
areas.definition: Required information is accidentally removed.

areas.title: Counters
areas.definition: Stored values drift away from actual totals.

areas.title: Data validation
areas.definition: Invalid information enters persistent storage.

areas.title: Data isolation
areas.definition: Information belonging to different entities is incorrectly associated.

areas.title: Initialization
areas.definition: The application never reaches a ready state.

areas.title: Goal creation
areas.definition: A post exists, but internal state is not correctly updated.

areas.title: Goal completion
areas.definition: The subscriber target is reached but not recognized.

areas.title: Successor creation
areas.definition: A completed goal never receives its required replacement.

areas.title: Recovery states
areas.definition: The application remains indefinitely stuck in recovery.

areas.title: Terminal states
areas.definition: Recoverable conditions are incorrectly classified as permanent.

areas.title: Partial completion
areas.definition: Only some required steps of an operation succeed.

areas.title: State synchronization
areas.definition: Reddit and Redis disagree about the current state.

areas.title: Promises
areas.definition: Operations are started but never awaited when completion is required.

areas.title: Race conditions
areas.definition: Execution order produces incorrect results.

areas.title: Concurrent writes
areas.definition: One operation incorrectly overwrites another.

areas.title: Locks and leases
areas.definition: Stale or incorrectly managed locks prevent future operations.

areas.title: Idempotency checks
areas.definition: Legitimate operations are incorrectly treated as duplicates.

areas.title: Timeouts
areas.definition: Operations stop without appropriate recovery.

areas.title: Parallel operations
areas.definition: Partial failures are ignored.

areas.title: Retry mechanisms
areas.definition: Operations are never retried, or retries are exhausted without appropriate resolution.

areas.title: Background tasks
areas.definition: Tasks fail outside the original execution context without detection.

areas.title: Scheduler registration
areas.definition: Required jobs are never registered.

areas.title: Scheduler execution
areas.definition: Registered jobs never run.

areas.title: Job cancellation
areas.definition: Required future jobs are accidentally cancelled.

areas.title: Time calculations
areas.definition: Operations are scheduled for incorrect times.

areas.title: Expiration checks
areas.definition: Valid records are incorrectly considered expired.

areas.title: Cooldowns
areas.definition: Cooldowns never reset or expire correctly.

areas.title: Delayed operations
areas.definition: Operations become invalid while waiting for execution.

areas.title: Recurring jobs
areas.definition: Recurring operations silently stop recurring.

areas.title: Empty catch blocks
areas.definition: Exceptions are swallowed without appropriate handling.

areas.title: Broad catch blocks
areas.definition: Unrelated errors are incorrectly treated identically.

areas.title: Fallback values
areas.definition: Failures are disguised as legitimate results.

areas.title: Fallback operations
areas.definition: Secondary operations also fail silently.

areas.title: Error classification
areas.definition: Temporary failures are incorrectly treated as permanent.

areas.title: Recovery logic
areas.definition: Recovery operations introduce additional failures.

areas.title: Cleanup operations
areas.definition: Resources or incorrect state remain after failures.

areas.title: Success reporting
areas.definition: Success is reported despite incomplete or incorrect execution.

areas.title: Post listings
areas.definition: Valid posts are omitted from results.

areas.title: Pagination
areas.definition: Relevant records exist beyond the retrieved results.

areas.title: NSFW filtering
areas.definition: Relevant content is silently excluded.

areas.title: Community visibility
areas.definition: Private, restricted, or public communities behave differently than expected.

areas.title: Highlight management
areas.definition: Goals are no longer highlighted despite internal state indicating otherwise.

areas.title: Moderator permissions
areas.definition: The application loses required permissions without recognizing the loss.

areas.title: App account restrictions
areas.definition: The application account cannot access expected functionality.

areas.title: Rate limiting
areas.definition: Operations are delayed or abandoned without appropriate recovery.

areas.title: Subscriber counts
areas.definition: Stale or incorrect subscriber counts prevent accurate goal tracking or completion.

areas.title: API response changes
areas.definition: Previously valid assumptions about Reddit API responses become incorrect.

areas.title: Conditional rendering
areas.definition: Required interface elements are not displayed.

areas.title: Responsive layouts
areas.definition: Buttons or other functionality disappear on certain screen sizes.

areas.title: Loading states
areas.definition: The interface remains indefinitely in a loading state.

areas.title: State updates
areas.definition: The interface displays outdated or incorrect information.

areas.title: Translations
areas.definition: Missing or invalid translations produce empty or incorrect text.

areas.title: Text overflow
areas.definition: Important information becomes invisible or inaccessible.

areas.title: Client compatibility
areas.definition: Functionality behaves differently across Reddit clients.

areas.title: Disabled controls
areas.definition: Controls remain disabled after operations complete.

areas.title: Rendering failures
areas.definition: Components disappear or fail to render without producing backend errors.

areas.title: App manifest
areas.definition: Required capabilities, handlers, or permissions are not registered.

areas.title: Environment variables
areas.definition: Missing configuration activates unintended defaults.

areas.title: Version compatibility
areas.definition: Older installations behave incorrectly following updates.

areas.title: Dependency updates
areas.definition: Library behavior changes without producing compilation errors.

areas.title: Build configuration
areas.definition: Required functionality is excluded from the application build.

areas.title: Deployment
areas.definition: Production behavior differs unexpectedly from playtest behavior.

areas.title: Installation-specific settings
areas.definition: Individual communities develop incompatible or invalid configurations.

areas.title: Before function entry
areas.definition: Required functions are never invoked.

areas.title: Before first log statement
areas.definition: Execution exits before diagnostics begin.

areas.title: Unlogged branches
areas.definition: Incorrect execution paths leave no diagnostic evidence.

areas.title: Client-side execution
areas.definition: Failures never reach backend logging.

areas.title: Log filtering
areas.definition: Important diagnostic information is suppressed.

areas.title: Success-only logging
areas.definition: Failed or skipped operations remain invisible.

areas.title: Missing postcondition checks
areas.definition: Operations are assumed successful without verifying the intended outcome.

areas.title: Missing reconciliation
areas.definition: Internal and external states diverge without detection.

areas.title: Missing activity
areas.definition: The absence of an expected event or operation is never recognized.

characteristics.title: Silent incorrect execution
characteristics.definition: Executes but produces an incorrect, incomplete, or unintended result without reporting a failure.

characteristics.title: Silent non-execution
characteristics.definition: Should execute but never does, so its own logging and error handling cannot detect the failure.

characteristics.title: External silent failure
characteristics.definition: Originates outside the app, such as Reddit not delivering an event or returning incomplete data.

characteristics.title: Transient silent failure
characteristics.definition: Temporarily disrupts functionality but may self-resolve through later runs, retries, or reconciliation.

characteristics.title: Persistent silent failure
characteristics.definition: Leaves an installation, goal, interaction, or workflow broken indefinitely without recovery or notification.
